title: Complete Intro to Flamenco Dance Class

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides detailed cultural background and structure before guiding students step by step. She breaks down complex movements into counts and rhythms using clear demonstrations and verbal counting.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and welcomes beginners to the workshop.
Teacher explains what flamenco is, its origins with the Romani people, and its cultural evolution.
Teacher explains flamenco rhythms (palos) and specifically tangos.
Teacher breaks down the four-count compas and hand clapping (palmas).
Teacher practices palmas along with guitar music.
Teacher explains arm and upper body posture and wrist movement.

common_mistakes: Keeping arms straight instead of rounded
Moving arms along with the hands

steps_taught.name: Hand clapping rhythm in compas
steps_taught.description: Hand clapping in a four-count compas rhythm for tangos.

what_works: Clear verbal explanations of rhythm and structure
Step-by-step breakdown of counts before adding music
what_hinders: Long periods of talking before physical demonstration

quotes.text: Before we begin, let's talk about what is flamenco.
Each measure is called a compas.
Our arms are always going to be rounded.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing the camera in a dance studio speaking to the audience.
Teacher demonstrates counting with hand gestures.

extraction.distinctive_method: Explaining the cultural and musical definition of compas and palos extensively before applying them to physical practice.
